EVD-001-001.claim: Use exact local Git exclude patterns managed in .git/info/exclude.
EVD-001-001.rationale: Use exact local Git exclude patterns managed in .git/info/exclude.

EVD-001-002.claim: Treat context as a current snapshot and user choices as an append-only ledger.
EVD-001-002.rationale: Treat context as a current snapshot and user choices as an append-only ledger.
